_comment: An example mod made of one content pack. Copy this folder into user-content/ to try it. docs/anotherworld/design-content-database.md lists the fields.
name: Balance Tweak
author: OB64: Another World
description: Raises the Short Sword's STR and lowers its price, and gives Wizards more INT. The simplest kind of mod: a few named fields in one JSON file.
